title: Natural restricted tensor pullback stalk comparison
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Z and z a point of V. Put S=O_Y,i(z), R=O_V,z [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with S-algebra map the composite of i.stalkMap and V.ι.stalkMap. There exists a family of additive equivalences from the stalk on V of the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] of every Y-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to R tensor over S with F_i(z). The family intertwines the restricted pullback stalk map of every morphism c:F→G with baseChange R of c.stalkLinearMap. This holds for arbitrary scheme morphisms and module sheaves.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 6.26.4, with tensor-pullback composition (0097) and open restriction

proof.text: Use the restriction adjunction and tensor-pullback adjunction to identify open restriction with tensor pullback along V.ι. Compose this with nonempty_tensorPullbackComp to identify tensorPullback i followed by restriction with tensorPullback (V.ι ≫ i). Whisker by the module stalk functor at z and compose with exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso. Rewrite the composite stalk map with Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp. The component linear equivalences give the additive equivalences β; evaluation of the composite natural isomorphism naturality equation gives precisely the desired baseChange equality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restricted_tensorPullback_stalk
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (V : Z.Opens) (z : V.toScheme) :
    let S := (Y.presheaf.stalk (i z.1) : Type u)
    let R := (V.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z : Type u)
    let φ : S →+* R := (i.stalkMap z.1 ≫ V.ι.stalkMap z).hom
    letI : Algebra S R := φ.toAlgebra
    ∃ β : ∀ (F : Y.Modules),
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj F)).presheaf.stalk z ≃+
          R ⊗[S] F.presheaf.stalk (i z.1),
      ∀ (F G : Y.Modules) (c : F ⟶ G) (x),
        β G (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).map c)).stalkLinearMap z x) =
        (c.stalkLinearMap (i z.1)).baseChange R (β F x)
